test.description: Cross-tile symbol matching on a dense layer of coincident points sharing one text key (260 symbols for the key, above the KDBush indexing threshold). The map crosses a zoom level and renders 300ms into a 1000ms fade window after the z3 placement: the two labels placed at z2 must keep their crossTileIDs across the zoom (staying fully opaque instead of re-fading in) and the coincident duplicates must stay hidden. Guards the findMatches lowest-index claim against label-fade regressions. 'wait' logic: 1st 'wait 1000' completes the initial fade-in at z2, 'wait' after 'setZoom' runs until the z3 tiles load, the next 'wait 1000' gets past the placement throttle (stillRecent) so a placement including the z3 buckets is committed, and the final 'wait 300' renders mid-fade: any symbol that failed to match its z2 counterpart would render at ~30% opacity here.

text-font: Open Sans Semibold,Arial Unicode MS Bold
